results.detail: Local pg_dump pg_dump (PostgreSQL) 18.7 through the session pooler as postgres. Plain dump exit 0; custom-format dump exit 0. Plain dump carries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY true (as ALTER TABLE), FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY true (as ALTER TABLE ONLY), CREATE POLICY true, the function true.

results.title: the restore role: create database, pg_restore --no-owner, RLS on the restored table
results.detail: As postgres: create role s30_restorer LOGIN CREATEDB, s30_app granted to it WITH ADMIN OPTION -> ok. As s30_restorer over the session pooler: create database -> ok. pg_restore --no-owner --no-privileges into it as s30_restorer -> exit 0. Restored table: relrowsecurity true, relforcerowsecurity true, owner s30_restorer, policies 1, rows visible to the owner under FORCE 0 (the source held 9); after NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY the owner counted 9 rows.

results.title: what ADMIN OPTION on an application role lets the restore role do
results.detail: As s30_restorer: grant s30_app to s30_reader -> ok (membership rows afterwards 1); revoke it -> ok; grant pg_read_all_data (no ADMIN on it) to s30_reader -> 42501 permission denied to grant role "pg_read_all_data".
